# Copilot working rules

- Work on the smallest possible scope.
- Do not inspect, search, read, or modify unrelated files.
- Before editing multiple files, give a concise plan and wait for approval.
- For fixes, use the specific files and error supplied by the user first.
- Do not run broad repository scans, full test suites, builds, or linting unless explicitly requested.
- Do not refactor unrelated code.
- Return concise explanations and minimal diffs.
- When a task is ambiguous, ask one clarifying question instead of exploring the repository.
- Prefer editing one file at a time.
